additions.text: US$0.99 for the first 10 days. Then renews automatically at US$19.90/month. Cancel anytime.

10 days for US$0.99: for teachers with an account and no earlier payments on SPANISHCUE, by card or PayPal. You pay US$0.99 today; after 10 days US$19.90 is charged automatically and then every month, unless you cancel first (if you took it before 26 November 2026, the charge comes after 7 days). The offer can be taken until 30 November 2026 at 23:59 (Argentina time).
10% off the first month: for signed-in teachers without active PRO, card only. You pay US$17.91 for the first month and then US$19.90/month. It cannot be combined with the US$0.99 10-day offer.
